name: Pidilite Industries Ltd.
description: Pidilite is India"s leading adhesives and sealants company, best known for the Fevicol brand. Dominates the Indian adhesive market with ~70% market share in white glue and ~50% in construction chemicals. Manufacturing presence across 18 plants in India.
honest_assessment: Absolute market leader in adhesives - Fevicol has become a generic name for glue in India. For B2B procurement (construction chemicals, industrial adhesives, waterproofing), Pidilite offers the widest product range. However, their pricing power means you pay 15-25% premium over imports. Their Dr. Fixit waterproofing range is the market standard for commercial construction. For price-sensitive industrial applications (packaging adhesives, lamination), consider alternatives like Henkel or local manufacturers. Service and technical support are excellent.
address: Regent Chambers, 7th Floor, Jamnalal Bajaj Marg, 208, Nariman Point, Mumbai - 400021
